This is sample text for demonstrating Deflate compression.

Deflate is a lossless data compression algorithm that combines LZ77 and Huffman coding. It is the foundation for GZIP, ZLIB, and PNG formats.

Key features:
1. Efficient compression - typically achieves 60-80% compression ratio for text
2. Widely used - ZIP files, HTTP compression all use Deflate
3. Raw format - optional zlib header support
